description: This file defines the GameManager class for a 2048 game implementation, including game setup, tile movement, merging logic, and game state management.

classes.name: GameManager
classes.description: Main class managing the game state, user interactions, and game logic for 2048.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the game, clearing the game state and resetting the grid.

methods.name: keepPlaying
methods.description: Allows the game to continue after reaching 2048 tile.

methods.name: isGameTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the game is over or has been won without the player choosing to keep playing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the game, loading previous state if available or starting fresh.

methods.name: addStartTiles
methods.description: Adds the initial tiles to start the game.

methods.name: addRandomTile
methods.description: Adds a new tile (2 or 4) in a random available position.

methods.name: actuate
methods.description: Updates the game state in storage and updates the display via the actuator.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the current game state into an object.

methods.name: prepareTiles
methods.description: Prepares tiles for movement by saving positions and clearing merge info.

methods.name: moveTile
methods.description: Moves a tile to a new cell and updates its position.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Executes a move in the specified direction, merging tiles as appropriate.

methods.name: getVector
methods.description: Returns the movement vector for a given direction.

methods.name: buildTraversals
methods.description: Builds traversal order for moving tiles based on direction.

methods.name: findFarthestPosition
methods.description: Finds the farthest position a tile can move to in a given direction.

methods.name: movesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if any moves are available.

methods.name: tileMatchesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if any tiles can be merged.

methods.name: positionsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two positions are the same.
